newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -JGBS SEEN DRIFTING LOWER TOWARD 125.70.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -JGBS SEEN DRIFTING LOWER TOWARD 125.70.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: INJECTION OF 300 BLN YEN
*Key September 10-year JGB futures are expected to drift lower toward 125.80 to 125.70 on Thursday, retaining weakness from the previous day's trade.
*Market's focus on whether investors will start buying again on the downside, traders said. *Aggressive downside try unlikely ahead of June machinery orders data due on Friday.
